processed_text: A 54-year-old female patient from a rural village reports feeling constant tiredness, occasional dizziness, and swelling in her feet for the past few weeks. She has a known history of diabetes for around 6 years and was told earlier that her blood pressure is sometimes high, but she does not check it regularly. She takes her medicines inconsistently because of household and farm work. Her last health center visit was approximately 3 months ago. Diet mainly consists of rice and minimal vegetables, with low protein intake. A small wound on her right toe has been present for over 10 days and is slow to heal. No recent fever or chest pain reported, but she feels weak while walking short distances.
